ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Paragraph.helper: Enter the text for paragraph. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

Image.helper: Choose the image or file to use for image. Use a clear file that fits this content.

Classes.helper: Enter the classes to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

AltText.helper: Describe the image for people who use screen readers. Leave this blank only when the image is decorative.
